checks.message: Provisional boundary is present and labeled; replace with official redline before professional scoring.
Three required key areas are provisional and labeled; replace with official polygons before professional scoring.
Initial land-use polygons are derived from site boundary partitioning and use standard land_use codes.
Static HTML visualization is generated without external dependencies.
Proposal includes references to standards, design depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, and assumptions.
English translation file exists and matches chapter structure of proposal.md.
Metrics include site_area_sqm, key_area_count, green_ratio, public_space_ratio, scenario_count, persona_count, landmark_count, phasing_phase_count, building_count, and other required items.
Assumptions cover boundary, area, roads, buildings, phasing, OSM, cases, AI scenarios, landmarks, operation, culture, and source registry boundaries.
Compliance matrix covers announcement tasks 1.3, 1.4, 1.5 and agent tasks agent.1–agent.6.

Standard matrix covers all mandatory standards from index.json including project announcement, agent taskbook, urban design measures, control detailed planning, land use classification, generative AI interim measures, barrier-free environment law, and elderly smart tech plan.

Design depth matrix covers all required depth items including existing conditions, three-level scope, spatial structure, land use, intensity controls, height/massing, retain/renovate/demolish, traffic/rail/slow/parking, municipal/new infrastructure, blue-green/public space, three key areas, renewal project list, phasing, metrics recalculation, and risk/missing data.
All five required figures are present: site-overview.png, land-use-structure.png, key-areas.png, mobility-bluegreen.png, metrics-evidence.png.
Scenario cards are presented in readable tables in the body text, not only in JSON.
Three AI pilgrimage landmarks have names and descriptions: Heritage Tower, Open Source Honor Wall, AI Governance Outlook.
Cultural narrative includes Jingzhang Railway history, Zhongguancun innovation culture, AI new culture, signage system, and international communication copy.
Operation mechanism includes annual event system, developer community operation, scenario open operation, international communication, and conversion pathway with specific arrangements.
Boundary statement present: all spatial recommendations are concept proposals, not replacing formal planning or constituting government conclusions.
